event.wren_heart2.3.text: Wait. That's a face. Not the drink's fault, I think. Sit a minute. The stool's yours as long as you need.
event.wren_heart2.3.why: frightened: the joke yields to gentleness

event.wren_heart2.3.text: Wait. That's a face. The drink, or the walk over? The light's been odd all week. Sit. Blink twice for drinkable.

event.wren_heart5.3.text: It's the quiet hours I mind. An empty room has an echo. Eleven seconds. Tonight it ran long. Stay till it's short again.

event.wren_heart5.2.text: Take a bottle, so the road has company. And home before dark on the fourth. Humor me. Some nights I keep, not pour.
event.wren_heart5.2.why: clue: the fourth, and 'keep' slipped and covered

event.hall_dance.1.text: Look at this room! Full, and the porch too. Somebody count the porch. I like knowing exactly who's in and who's out tonight.

event.hall_dance.2.text: I saved this bottle for a night the hall was full. First glass is yours, [player]. Poured before the doors. A hall this bright shows a long way. Good. Let it show.
event.hall_dance.2.why: defiant warmth toward the dark outside

event.reading_night.3.text: Ignore me, I'm off duty. I wanted a room with this many lamps in it. Read on. I'm not going anywhere tonight.
event.reading_night.3.why: frightened: she stays for the light

event.reading_night.3.text: Ignore me, I'm off duty. Some stories I don't improve. I came to sit where the lamp is and hear one of those.
event.reading_night.3.why: uneasy: one true category of story

event.past_the_point.wren.text: I open at noon. That leaves me mornings, and I spend them here. The sea doesn't watch you back. I needed one thing that doesn't.
event.past_the_point.wren.why: clue: something at home watches; bag.go meaning kept

event.story_cat.intro.text: Don't move. The cat picked your boots, and cats pick the person who needs sitting on. Stand still and be sat on. Bartender's orders.
Don't move. The cat has chosen your boots. Good. It's been fussy all week, staring down the forest road like it's owed money.
event.story_cat.intro.why: wakefulness ladder: animals face the wood

event.wren_heart4.prank.text: Settle in, everybody. One night only: the worst song ever written, performed softly, by its deeply sorry author. You're safe to laugh here.
event.wren_heart4.prank.why: the shout softens; permission to laugh

event.wren_heart6.intro.text: Come into the back. You look like a long week. I'm cooking, you taste, nobody hears it was me, and for one hour the week stays outside.
event.wren_heart6.intro.why: uneasy: she reads the player's tiredness

dlg.wren.bag.1.text: I came to rest one season. Eight years ago. Something here needed keeping, and I'm good at keeping. So. Go, stay, or leave it under there?
dlg.wren.bag.1.why: clue slipped and covered; choice setup unchanged

event.wren_heart8.after.text: There. I said it out loud, and the bag weighs less. Yours would too, whatever you're carrying lately. Don't tell anyone. This one I won't improve.
event.wren_heart8.after.why: frightened: she turns the relief toward the player

event.wren_heart10.intro.text: Chairs up, lamps low. One song, one listener. Most of what I do for this village is quiet and never gets a room. Tonight does. The good stool. Yes, you.
event.wren_heart10.intro.why: revelation-tier slip: her unseen work, uncovered no further

event.wren_friend.doing.text: Square three: Bram said four words. Square four: the fog stayed past noon again. One of them I made up. Guess which.
event.wren_friend.doing.why: a true oddity hidden among rumors

event.wren_birthday.intro.text: My birthday! You came, with that much on your shoulders. That counts double. Sit down. Have a pickle from the good jar.

dlg.wren.partners.r2.text: A walk home. Past Tilda's lamp. She leaves it burning for whoever's still out. We're careful about our own here. Lead on.
dlg.wren.partners.r2.why: clue: Keepers' shared exact care; walk meaning kept

event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l1.text: You're flat on the third bar. Fabulously flat. Again. The room's been eating notes all week.
event.overheard_wren_piper_1.l1.why: uneasy: the song loses a note

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1.text: Last song, Piper. Soft. The kind that settles a room. No chorus. Just see everyone home easy.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1.why: frightened: she shepherds the room home

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1.text: Last song tonight, Piper. Early close. New moon tomorrow, and I keep my own hours around the new moon.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1.why: hint: her canonical early-close tell, warmly excused

event.overheard_tilda_wren_2.l2.text: I heard it first. Three days ago. It's grown since. Most stories do. The ones that matter, we keep trimmed.

event.overheard_tilda_wren_3.l4.text: The slate will wait. It's good at that. So am I. Waiting's half this village's trade.
event.overheard_tilda_wren_3.l4.why: uneasy: waiting as the village's craft

event.overheard_wren_bram_3.l3.text: Four words. Worth a fish. ...I'm not going anywhere, Bram. Somebody has to keep the lights on.
event.overheard_wren_bram_3.l3.why: frightened: the win muted, the duty showing

event.overheard_wren_hazel_1.l3.text: And which one's true? Careful. You write down everything I say. I'd hate to be a pattern.
event.overheard_wren_hazel_1.l3.why: Keeper lightly aware of the resister's notebook

event.overheard_wren_hazel_2.l3.text: One line's a start. The corner stool's yours. Lately everybody needs somewhere that just listens.

event.overheard_wren_hazel_3.l4.text: Between us, we always were. Whatever you think of me some nights, that part's true. Now, the line.
event.overheard_wren_hazel_3.l4.why: gentle to the one who suspects her

adds.text: You're safe in this room. I don't say that as a hope. I say it as a fact I work at.
adds.why: clue-tier: a Keeper's protection stated plainly, unexplained

adds.text: It won't cross the tree line, either. Smart animal. Follows village rules better than most of us.
adds.why: hint: an odd custom offered as cat trivia

cuts.why: 'commit' is a push a frightened player shouldn't get; the .3 variant fills the softened beat

notes: wren_heart4 variants are written to the build (Wren sings her own worst song), per the standing r1/r2 bible-vs-build flag.
Locked hinges untouched: the 'Stay.' echo (dlg.wren.bag.r1), hall_dance.9 after Marcus's 'Finished', and overheard_tilda_wren_3.l2 'Come at seven'.
My canonical new-moon early-close tell now lives in the overheard_wren_piper_3 hint variant; if the Director wants that tell exclusive to mythos.wren.*, cut that one variant.
Deliberate rhyme: cozy heart5 'come back before four' against the clue variant's 'home before dark on the fourth' (ritual night is day 4); flag if too loud.
The heart2 cut pairs with the event.wren_heart2.3 full-dread variant, which fills the softened beat.
overheard_wren_bram_3 full-dread variant says 'I'm not going anywhere' before Bram's 'Don't go far'; his reply still lands as affirmation, but Director should confirm the seam.
